usage: Bots should not be repo admins
name: Bots should not be repo admins
description: Bot users are not real users of your organization or first-level group and as such may pose a great security risk if their account gets compromised. They should be admins of a repo in exceptional cases.
detailedDescription: Bot users are not real users of your organization or first-level group. A best practice is to limit the access time and permissions they have to a repository. Given that no real user is behind a bot, a compromise of a bot may go undetected for a large period of time.

args.name: botSubStrings
args.label: Bot Identification Strings
args.tooltip: Strings that will be used to identify bots in your organization

args.name: ignoreIfAdminActivity
args.label: Ignore if admin activity seen
args.tooltip: This will ignore all bots that have known admin activity. Note: This setting will be ignored if Audit Log permissions are not available

args.name: baselineCount
args.label: Ignore if user is admin in multiple repos
args.tooltip: This will ignore all bots that are admins of more than the selected number of repos
